passage.text: Today I spent the day at an elephant camp near Chiang Mai.
passage.reading: təˈdeɪ aɪ ˈspɛnt ðə ˈdeɪ ət ən ˈɛləfənt ˈkæmp ˈnɪr ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

passage.text: It's a rescue camp for old and sick elephants.
passage.reading: ɪts ə ˈrɛskjuː ˈkæmp fər ˈoʊld ənd ˈsɪk ˈɛləfənts.

passage.text: Most of them worked in the forest for many years.
passage.reading: ˈmoʊst əv ðɛm ˈwɜːrkt ɪn ðə ˈfɔːrɪst fər ˈmɛni ˈjɪrz.

passage.text: In the morning, I helped the staff prepare the elephants' food.
passage.reading: ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, aɪ ˈhɛlpt ðə ˈstæf prɪˈpɛr ði ˈɛləfənts ˈfuːd.

passage.text: One elephant can eat about two hundred kilos of food a day!
passage.reading: ˈwʌn ˈɛləfənt kən ˈiːt əˈbaʊt ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd ˈkiːloʊz əv ˈfuːd ə ˈdeɪ!

passage.text: The elephants are huge, but they're very calm.
passage.reading: ði ˈɛləfənts ər ˈhjuːdʒ, bʌt ðɛr ˈvɛri ˈkɑːm.

passage.text: A young elephant took a banana from my hand with her trunk.
passage.reading: ə ˈjʌŋ ˈɛləfənt ˈtʊk ə bəˈnænə frəm maɪ ˈhænd wɪð hɜːr ˈtrʌŋk.

passage.text: In the afternoon, we washed the elephants in the river.
passage.reading: ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnuːn, wiː ˈwɑːʃt ði ˈɛləfənts ɪn ðə ˈrɪvər.

passage.text: They love playing in the mud!
passage.reading: ðeɪ ˈlʌv ˈpleɪɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈmʌd!

passage.text: At the end of the day, I was tired, and my clothes were brown with mud.
passage.reading: ət ði ˈɛnd əv ðə ˈdeɪ, aɪ wʌz ˈtaɪərd, ənd maɪ ˈkloʊðz wɜːr ˈbraʊn wɪð ˈmʌd.

passage.text: But it was the best day I've ever had!
passage.reading: bʌt ɪt wʌz ðə ˈbɛst ˈdeɪ aɪv ˈɛvər ˈhæd!
